scope: Static review of authorized private member credential loading and genuine Notes native login; no credential, environment, browser, build, test, release, or Store access.

evidence: The credential path is used only for NOTES_ROLE=member, conflicts with interactive member mode, and opens the exact www.aimatrx.com/login page. The runner fills the site's email/password controls and submits its Sign in button.

After submission, /api/whoami must report a signed-in email matching both the private fixture fingerprint and the exact credential email. The extension's own Sign in then must show that email, a stored user profile and token, and a canonical admin.admins GET with zero rows for that extension user id.

The existing imported-artifact verifier runs before and after the native attempt. No actual private fixture or authenticated member session was read or run in this review, so real login and D61/D62/D63/D67/D68 acceptance remain unverified.
verdict_a_outcome.next_evidence: An exclusive, separately authorized native run must establish the genuine web and extension identities and complete the Notes cases on the attested artifact.

evidence: The private credential reader requires an owned regular file with mode 0600 and O_NOFOLLOW, exact email/password JSON fields, a nonempty password, and the designated reviewer email fingerprint before returning credentials.

Reader errors use fixed codes; the Notes runner catches them into fixed failure_code values, discards caught browser errors, and records only the reviewer fingerprint. No credential value is interpolated into a report, log, or assertion. The login form names and Sign in button match the current frontend source.

The new tests cover accepted fixture shape, wrong fingerprint, broad mode, final-path symlink, malformed/expanded JSON, and missing inputs. They use synthetic values; this review did not execute them.
limits: The fixture's authorization and ability to log in are external facts; UID/mode/fingerprint checks cannot prove a working password or a live member organization role.

The organization picker proves visible membership and fresh selection; it does not prove that the selected organization's IAM role is member. Report non-admin extension identity and organization membership only unless separate role evidence is obtained.
